notes.title: Groovity Demo: Speedrun Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/138188cedfd4f90a0f0c5ec13c3590078e0a31c5.png"]
Dear speedrunners, Groovity Demo just received an important update!
We've listened to your feedback and bring a new feature that will unleash your speedy side. At Beyond Toppings' office we've worked on a Victory Screen!

After finishing a level, you can now check the time it took, as well as the deaths and Miuris you collected. We all have speedrunner friends, so don't be shy to share the demo with them to bring out your best skills. We want to see your most stunning videos, but more importantly we want to see how much fun you have trying to finish the Demo in the fastest time possible.

Challenge yourself to get the best times and share them with others!

In the future we will announce more details about new updates, so keep an eye on us! Many thanks for your continued support through your downloads and comments, they give us the strength to keep expanding Groovity.

Beyond Toppings Team



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/b2c9d82b2f1e0cc3eaf0379d379fbfbc67f74e37.png"]
